salonAudience.widen: Widening to men & women keeps every service, staff member and booking; the owner is notified.
salonAudience.narrow: Narrowing switches off the services that no longer fit (and bride options for a men's salon). It is refused while future bookings exist.
salonAudience.conflicts: {{count}} future booking(s) block this change. Resolve them first (cancel or complete), then try again.
